entry.title: New: Resolution 208 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO HAWAIʻI WILDLIFE FUND

Approves a grant of $15,748 to Hawaiʻi Wildlife Fund, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization for protection of native wildlife and preservation of the Kahuku Coastal Property in Kaʻū, (Tax Map Key: 9-2-001:075), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 208-23 & LAAC-26 - 08/16/23
